info.title: zen API
info.description: The only write path for every zen client (web, extension, Android, iOS). Additive only: new endpoints and new optional fields are fine; removing or renaming a field, changing a type, or making an optional field required is a breaking change and is refused by CI (`oasdiff breaking`).

post.summary: Sign in with the local password

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set.

get.summary: Read one card, with what links to it and from it

patch.summary: Edit, tag, pin, link, restore or resurface a card

get.summary: Same Vibe: a moodboard built from one image card

post.summary: Create a space (or a Smart Space, given a query)

patch.summary: Add or remove a card, or share/unshare the space

post.summary: Ask the drop a question, answered from this mind's cards

200.description: An answer, a grilled question, a running task's result, or none.

post.summary: Answer one open question the agent grilled

delete.summary: Undo one logged agent or drop action

get.summary: Every card, space, membership and link this mind owns

post.summary: Import a zen export, a card array, bookmark HTML or a CSV
Upload a file as a card: multipart directly, or the cloud's ticket-then-PUT flow (JSON)

get.summary: A stored upload's bytes (redirects to storage in the cloud)
get.description: No auth: the file name is an unguessable capability (a random id), the same model a signed URL uses. Anyone holding the name can read the file, and no one can guess a name they were not given.

post.summary: Model Context Protocol server (JSON-RPC 2.0) — zen as memory for other AI assistants

CardInput.description: A new card: give a url, a note, a quote, or any mix.

SpaceInput.description: parent must be one of this mind's own space ids, or it is dropped.

AskAnswerInput.description: Answers an open question the agent grilled; answer is truncated server-side to 300 characters.

SettingsPatch.description: One of the app's locale codes (vi, en, ko, zh, ja).

McpRequest.description: method: initialize | ping | tools/list | tools/call. For tools/call, params = {name, arguments}; arguments per tool: search_memory -> McpSearchArgs, get_card -> McpGetCardArgs, save_card -> McpSaveCardArgs, ask_zen -> McpAskArgs.

Card.description: A saved card: a note, link, image or other kind of memory.

Space.description: A named, or query-based smart, group of cards.

Export.description: Every card (embeddings left out), space, membership and link this mind owns.

McpResponse.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 result or error envelope.

McpSaveCardArgs.description: note or url is required (checked at runtime, not expressible in this shape).

cookieAuth.name: zen_session
cookieAuth.description: The web session cookie, set by POST /login. Used by the web app and the browser extension.

bearerAuth.description: A Supabase access token in the cloud, or the local session token in local mode. Used by native apps.
